name: Kino Remote
description: Handheld Ancient controller for the Kino reconnaissance orbs. Opens the ship map, ship systems, and the Kino fleet view.

name: Kino
description: A floating Ancient camera drone. Launch it from the Kino Remote to scout ahead — through the Stargate or down a corridor.

name: Rations
description: Vacuum-sealed crew meals salvaged from a supply crate. Keeps the crew fed.

name: Lime
description: Calcium compound mined off-world. Feeds the CO2 scrubber cartridge bed — the ship's air depends on it.

name: Small Fuse
description: A small replacement fuse looted from a Shuttle Dock crate. The jammed door panel's blown fuse looks about this size.

name: Large Fuse
description: A heavy-duty fuse looted from a Shuttle Dock crate. Too big for the jammed door panel — pocketed for later.

name: Marine Helmet
description: Standard-issue ballistic helmet recovered from the Icarus expedition kit. Offers head protection off-world.

name: Recon Cap
description: Lightweight soft cap for low-threat reconnaissance. Trades protection for a clear field of view.

name: Tactical Vest
description: Load-bearing tactical vest. Worn over the fatigues for carrying gear and light armor plating.

name: Field Backpack
description: Expedition rucksack for off-world excursions. Increases what the crew can haul back through the gate.

name: Combat Boots
description: Reinforced field boots and trousers. Standard footwear for surface missions.
